d: Jet black hair is styled with long, flowing locks, straight bangs covering the forehead, and two high pigtails tied with black bows. The eyes are an iridescent silver-white with a vacant, wide expression, set on a youthful face with a soft, immature appearance. A slender build is dressed in a light pink long-sleeved blouse featuring black ruffled trim, a large black bow at the chest, and black suspenders. Signature details include a black choker with a silver charm, a silver crescent moon hair ornament, and a thin purple strap crossing the torso.
